item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 08/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central part of the South China Sea. A fresh to strong easterly airstream will bring mainly fine and dry weather to the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. The easterly airstream is expected to moderate gradually midweek next week.
